parameters.content:
# How to set up this automation?

## 1. Make a copy of the [Reddit Google Spreadsheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1W3BP1fxhmWqJGmhaYTflLnd7l0N1RaQUzXeI3Y5b7Fo/edit?usp=sharing) to your Google Drive
## 2. Modify the Google Sheets nodes, select the one you just created
## 3. Start the AI Agents No-Code Toolkit server
## 4. Open the `Configure node`, and setup the server url
## 5. Create a free account on [Together AI](http://together.ai/), [create and API key](https://api.together.ai/settings/api-keys) and copy it
## 6. Setup the `Generate AI Image` Node - create a new Bearer Auth credential and paste the API key from Together AI
## 7. Setup the `Start YouTube upload` and `Upload video to YouTube` nodes - select/setup your YouTube credentials
## 8. Setup the rest of the `Configure node` based on your preference.
## 8. If you selected chatterbox with voice cloning, you can use your own audio sample, modify the `Download audio sample` node
## 10. Move the trigger node to #1 (Add stories) and run the workflow to fill up your spreadsheet with stories
## 11. Move the trigger node to #2 (Generate video) and run the workflow to generate a video
